claims: Dawn Staley is the head coach of the South Carolina Gamecocks women's basketball team.
Dawn Staley has held the position of head coach of the South Carolina Gamecocks women's basketball team since May 2008.
Dawn Staley is a Basketball Hall of Famer.
Dawn Staley won three NCAA National Championships in 2017, 2022, and 2024.
Dawn Staley led the South Carolina Gamecocks women's basketball team to a Final Four appearance in 2026.
Dawn Staley is a three-time Naismith National Coach of the Year.
As of January 17, 2025, Dawn Staley signed a contract extension making her the highest-paid coach in women’s college basketball.
Dawn Staley was a two-time Naismith Player of the Year at Virginia.
Dawn Staley is a three-time Olympic gold medalist.
Dawn Staley served as the head coach for the U.S. Women's National Team.
Dawn Staley won a gold medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics as head coach of the U.S. Women's National Team
